subject: Limit CLUSTER_CANT_FAILOVER_DATA_AGE log to 10 times period (#1189)
reason: The change only rate-limits one serverLog() notice in clusterLogCantFailover(): when a replica is repeatedly blocked from failover by CLUSTER_CANT_FAILOVER_DATA_AGE, the log is emitted every 10 seconds instead of every 1. It is logging-only: the new branch is a single comparison plus return, the caller's control flow and all failover/election decisions are unchanged, and cant_failover_reason is not exposed in any reply (not in CLUSTER INFO), so no command output, replication, or data path differs between the builds.
